description: This file contains the implementation of the AccessTokenRepository class, which manages OAuth access tokens including persistence, revocation, validation, creation, and retrieval within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the database through Doctrine ORM and follows OAuth2 server standards.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling OAuth2 access token data operations, including storing, revoking, verifying, creating, and retrieving access tokens.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Persists a new OAuth access token into the database, mapping properties from the OAuth access token entity to the database entity. Throws an exception if a unique constraint is violated.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Marks an access token as revoked in the database based on its token identifier.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a given access token has been revoked by querying the database.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new access token entity with provided client, scopes, and user identifier.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Fetches an access token entity from the database by its token identifier.
